decisions.reason: Location-based margin analysis builds on the firm's maintained market-data databases, has its own web page, and adds value for utilities at low marginal cost.
Gas tariff comparison is close to the core offer and draws on the same daily updated data, so keeping it costs little and supports platform expansion.
The regional electricity tariff calculator is a core-adjacent product with its own page and steady demand from suppliers and comparison needs.
The energy tariff calculator line is only mentioned on the website and may overlap with C, but it is likely to be consolidated within the platform rather than withdrawn.
The area definition tool supports the other location-based products and fits the integrated platform strategy.
Site-specific tariff comparison is close to the established offer, and its several models are cheap to maintain on shared data, despite limited website prominence.
